name: Waste-Item-Image-Classification
description: The Waste-Item-Image-Classification dataset contains images of waste items paired with a short instruction and a categorical material label (e.g., Plastic, Cardboard). It evaluates a model's ability to classify waste types from visual input.
card_text: This dataset is an image classification benchmark for waste sorting. Each sample includes an image of a single waste item (such as a plastic bottle or cardboard box) paired with the short text instruction 'Classify the waste type of the image' and a ground-truth category label. The images are everyday object photographs with relatively simple scenes focused on the item. The task is multiclass classification: given the image and instruction, the model must output the correct waste material category. The dataset assumes a closed set of waste categories, with 216 samples distributed across multiple waste types. It is designed to test visual recognition and material identification in a recycling context.

image.semantics: Photograph of a single waste item (e.g., plastic container, cardboard piece) that serves as the visual input for classification.

question.semantics: A short instruction asking the model to classify the waste type of the accompanying image.

answer.semantics: The waste material category label (e.g., Plastic, Cardboard) that corresponds to the image.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample contains an image of a waste item, a short text instruction prompting classification, and a single categorical answer label. The image is the visual input, the prompt is the instruction, and the answer is the waste category to predict. No dialog, options, or additional annotations are present.
